title: Zesty Canadian Garlic Skillet
description: A garlicky, gooey, one-pot Canadian dish featuring saffron and crispy fried chicken. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook, stirring occasionally, for 4 minutes or until fragrant.
Add the diced onion and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes or until softened.
Add the sliced potatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes or until they start to brown.
Add the chicken broth, saffron threads, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the chicken thighs, double-fried chicken, and chopped parsley (if using). Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and the potatoes are tender.
Reduce the heat to low and sprinkle the grated cheddar cheese (if using) over the top.
Cover the skillet with a lid and cook, stirring occasionally, for 2 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
